source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Interior door heights 2.1 m assumed; no internal door heights are drawn. Exterior door openings observed at 0.2..2.6 m on the elevations.
Ceiling height 4.5 m assumed equal to the observed building height in all four elevation chains (1700+1800+1000 etc.); no section is supplied.
Interior partitions drawn as ~120 mm line pairs; exterior walls 240 mm per '240' labels.
Interior door positions measured from pixels (+-30 mm); no interior dimension chain is drawn.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

unresolved: Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

scope.actual_openings: only explicit built source openings are inventoried

reused_calibration.basis: Plan 1f_view.png: overall chains 10000 (x) and 20000 (y); outer wall faces measured at px x=249..612.6, y=151.6(top/north)..877.5(bottom/south), 27.5 mm/px, north = up. Representative planes: exterior walls on their observed outer faces (thickness 240, labelled '240' on plan); interior partitions on measured line-pair midplanes, drawn ~120 thick. Exterior opening positions from the facade dimension chains (they sum to 10000/20000 on all four facades and match the drawn jambs within ~1 px); interior partition and door positions from pixel measurement (about +-30 mm). World y = north, x = east; z absolute, ground floor at 0.

This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound direct original returns from view_image or paired elevation views are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

current_claim_state.note: Current numerical/context consistency only; neither retained nor confirmed means drawing truth.

height_coverage.note: Coverage means a current adopted z binding, not proof that the drawing or BIM is correct. Inference and declared values do not count as located-image height evidence.

located_height_coverage.note: No height error is asserted. Each height needs its own source-region coverage in an explicitly calibrated elevation. Whole-image citations and absent calibration remain unverified; a shared height on different widths deserves a local check. Report only.

facade_counts.note: Compare observer-reported whole-floor/facade totals with actual source openings. Uncounted facades, zero totals, conflicting evidence and unresolved scopes stay explicit. Equal counts do not prove position or drawing fidelity. Report only.

floor_completeness.note: Floor coverage only; rooms, openings and drawing fidelity are not certified. Unspecified floor scope remains unknown.
